accounts.title: Test accounts
accounts.intro: A test account is a named, stored set of values for the settlement of a test run: initial capital, currency, leverage, spread and commission. It is not tied to an instrument.
accounts.empty: There is no test account. Next step: create a new one.
accounts.formEmpty: Next step: choose a test account on the left or create a new one.
accounts.loadError: The test accounts could not be read.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.deleteText: The test account "{{name}}" is deleted. Saved backtests keep their copy of the values.
accounts.deleteDefaultHint: pipwerk replay creates the built-in default test account again with its original values at the next start.
accounts.saveError: The test account could not be saved. {{reason}}
accounts.deleteError: The test account could not be deleted. {{reason}}

tip.name: The name under which you choose the test account in a test run.
tip.capital: The money a test run starts with.
tip.currency: The currency in which profit, loss and costs are shown. Three capital letters, for example EUR.
tip.leverage: How much more market value you can move with the money; 30 means 1:30.
tip.commission: Fee per traded lot, once for opening and once for closing, in account currency.
tip.spread: The spread is the distance between buy and sell price. "From the candles" takes the spread the broker delivers per candle; "fixed" uses a fixed value in points (a point is the smallest price step of the instrument).

problem.name: The name must be given (at most 100 characters, without control characters).
problem.capital: The initial capital must be greater than 0.
problem.currency: The account currency consists of exactly three capital letters, for example EUR.
problem.leverage: The leverage must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
problem.spread: The fixed spread must be a number from 0 to 100000 points.
problem.commission: The commission must be a number from 0 to 100000.

data.title: Data stock of historical price data
data.intro: The strategy tester reads price data only from this data stock. Here you see what is available, and you can import files by hand or acquire data by hand.
data.loadError: The data stock could not be read. {{reason}}
data.stockEmpty: The data stock is empty. Next step: import a file below or start the acquisition.
data.instrumentsIntro: These details preset the instrument details in a test run. There they can be changed for one test run.
data.instrumentsEmpty: There are no instrument details yet. Next step: acquire the details of an instrument below or import a file with them.
data.detailsError: The details of an instrument could not be read.
data.sourceIntro: The default source is the broker whose data a test run uses. You can choose it before any data is available.
data.sourceLoadError: The default source could not be read.
data.sourceEmpty: There is no data of any broker yet. Next step: enter the name of the broker whose data you want to use.
data.sourceInvalid: The name must not be empty, not longer than 128 characters and must not begin or end with a blank.
data.sourceSaveError: The default source could not be saved. {{reason}}

tip.sourceBroker: The name of the broker as it stands in the data stock, for example the name of the trade server. Choose from the list or type it.

import.title: Import a file by hand
import.intro: The import reads a file in JSON or CSV format, checks it and takes over the data. For example an export from MetaTrader 5 or a file from your hard disk. Existing data of the same moment is replaced.
import.empty: No file chosen yet. Next step: choose a file in JSON or CSV format.
import.formatUnknown: Format not recognised. JSON and CSV are allowed.
import.csvNote: A CSV file does not say which broker, instrument and time unit it belongs to and in which time zone its times are. Please give that here.
import.jsonNote: A JSON file contains broker, instrument and time unit itself. Nothing more is needed.
import.nextStep: Next step: fill in all fields with a star.
import.result: Result: {{accepted}} rows taken over, of them {{replaced}} replacing existing rows. The data stock is updated.
import.resultInstrument: Result: the details of the instrument {{instrument}} at {{broker}} are taken over.
import.rejectedCut: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rejected rows.

tip.choose: Chooses a file from your hard disk. The file is checked and never executed.
tip.broker: Which broker the data belongs to in the data stock, for example the name of the trade server.
tip.instrument: The instrument whose prices the file contains, for example EURUSD.
tip.kind: Candles of a time unit or ticks. Ticks are not built from candles and candles not from ticks.
tip.timeUnit: The candle length of the file, for example H1 for hourly candles.
tip.timezone: MetaTrader 5 exports the time of the trade server. Give its time zone by name, for example Europe/Athens. Daylight saving time is taken into account. pipwerk converts all times to UTC.

reject.columns_mismatch: The row has too few columns.
reject.field_unknown: The entry contains an unknown field.
reject.value_invalid: A value is not a valid number.
reject.time_out_of_range: The moment is outside the supported range (1970 to 2100).
reject.local_time_not_existing: This local time does not exist (change to daylight saving time).
reject.time_not_ascending: The moment is not after the moment of the row before.
reject.time_duplicate: The moment occurs more than once in the file.
reject.price_not_positive: A price is not greater than 0.

fileError.too_many_rows: The file has too many rows.
fileError.not_decodable: The text of the file cannot be read. Save it as UTF-8.
fileError.json_invalid: The file is not valid JSON.
fileError.document_invalid: The structure of the file does not match the format.
fileError.header_invalid: The header line of the CSV file does not fit. Expected are date and time as well as Open, High, Low and Close (candles) or Bid and Ask (ticks).
fileError.series_invalid: Broker, instrument or time unit are invalid.
fileError.timezone_unknown: The time zone is unknown. Give an IANA name, for example Europe/Athens.
fileError.period_invalid: The period of the file is invalid.

acquire.title: Start acquisition by hand
acquire.intro: The acquisition gets price data from the source that is set up, for example pipwerk-fetch-mt5 on the computer of MetaTrader 5, and takes it over into the data stock. Missing data of a test run will be acquired automatically later; here you start it yourself.
acquire.running: The acquisition is running. For long periods this can take minutes.
acquire.nextStepInstrument: Next step: name the instrument whose data you want to get.
acquire.periodInvalid: The period is invalid: the start must be before the end.
acquire.doneInstrument: Acquired and imported: the details of the instrument {{instrument}} at {{broker}}.

tip.instrument: The instrument whose data you want to get, for example EURUSD. The source must know it.
tip.kind: Candles of a time unit, ticks or the instrument details. Ticks are not built from candles; they must be there if a strategy has the trigger "Tick".
tip.timeUnit: The candle length, for example H1 for hourly candles.
tip.from: Start of the wanted data as date and time in UTC. This moment is included.
tip.to: End of the wanted data as date and time in UTC. This moment is no longer included; for a whole day choose 00:00 of the next day. For ticks and small time units choose short periods.

errors.no_source: No source is set up. Next step: enter the address and the key of the source in the startup configuration of pipwerk replay (see the user documentation).
errors.unauthorized: The source rejected the key. Check that the key is the same in both startup configurations.
errors.host_not_allowed: The source does not accept the request because the name of its address is not allowed there. Enter it in the startup configuration of the source.
errors.body_too_large: The request was too large for the source.
errors.invalid_request: The source considers the request invalid.
errors.not_found: The source does not know this path. Check the address of the source.
errors.symbol_unknown: The instrument is unknown at the broker. Check the spelling and the mapping in the source.
errors.no_data: The broker has no data for this period.
errors.range_too_large: The period is too large. Choose a smaller period.
errors.terminal_unavailable: MetaTrader 5 is unreachable. Check that it runs on the computer of the source and is logged in.
errors.broker_error: MetaTrader 5 ended the query with an error.
errors.broker_unknown: The name of the broker cannot be determined.
errors.invalid_broker_data: The broker delivers invalid details of the instrument.
errors.internal_error: An internal error occurred in the source.
errors.source_unreachable: Source unreachable. Check that the source is running and that the address in the startup configuration is right.
errors.source_response_invalid: The answer of the source is invalid.
errors.source_response_too_large: The answer of the source is too large. Choose a smaller period.
errors.import_refused: The import rejected the data of the source.
errors.import_refused_with: The import rejected the data of the source: {{reason}}
errors.data_store_error: The data stock could not be changed.
